question: Who made the first to record with the electric guitar?
text:
**Joseph Lopes** is believed to have played electric steel guitar on one of the earliest known commercial recordings to feature the instrument: **“Dreams of Aloha,”** recorded by **Noi Lane’s Hawaiian Orchestra** on **February 22, 1933**, in New York City. ([digital.library.adelaide.edu.au](https://digital.library.adelaide.edu.au/server/api/core/bitstreams/ecc1f0bd-8919-4158-9e78-afd241fa9864/content?utm_source=openai))

**Gage Brewer** played electric guitar publicly in Wichita, Kansas, in **October 1932**, but his surviving recording was never commercially released and its exact date is uncertain. ([flickr.com](https://www.flickr.com/photos/wichitahistory/4575035721?utm_source=openai))
